{{Quote|I am driven by passion, and allow others to do the same. This is pure.|Lord Trok|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Trok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. She overthrew a crime syndicate on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and started moving its members to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Unable to find concrete evidence against her, [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Manus]] used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Trok first appeared in Game Update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]]. She is only accessible through the Bounty Contract Week event quest series of the Empire players in the game on Dromund Kaas.
